d: Native PS Vita and PSTV port of The New Tetris, with ~60 FPS solo/CPU gameplay, intro, menus and Credits.
ld: A native port of The New Tetris for PS Vita and PlayStation TV. All eight solo stages and seven Single Player OPPONENT (vs. CPU) cultural backdrops are optimized for ~60 FPS; CPU Opponent stages were hardware-verified on Vita TV. New in v1.05: the developer splash, full Tetris in the Sand introduction, Press Start title, main and Single Player menus, New Name keyboard, Options, Data, Audio, Scores and scrolling Credits have been optimized for ~60 FPS and tested on handheld Vita. Original presentation timing, gameplay, soundtrack, sound effects, saved progression, Wonders construction/Hall and finale remain included. PlayStation TV supports local 2–4 player games, hardware-tested using four DS3/DS4 controllers; multiplayer gameplay and Wonder cinematics are not claimed to run at 60 FPS. This unofficial fan port involved substantial AI assistance and extensive hands-on debugging/testing. Original game resources are generated locally from a user-supplied compatible USA 1.0 N64 ROM; no commercial ROM or extracted media is included.
req: Requires a user-supplied compatible USA 1.0 The New Tetris N64 ROM in ux0:/data/TNTV/ (accepts z64, v64, n64); first launch generates assets locally. Multiplayer requires a PlayStation TV and multiple paired controllers.
